column1: # Lineages: a named, published line within a species that a read can be
# told apart by, kept under its species' name; or the informal name of a
# genus-level record (an "Oesophagostomum sp." lineage with no species). bin/build.py
# (--lineages) gives a record the lineage of its annotated members; the
# record's taxonomy is unchanged. Accession without version.
# Teladorsagia circumcincta goat line (Francis & Slapeta 2023, Parasitology
# 150:672-682): a 6-base insertion and 4 substitutions against the
# sheep-and-goat line. The same ITS2 type is in GenBank as genotype Mdh2C
# (Leignel et al., J Parasitol, in press per AF351782) and from an aoudad
# in Tunisia. The sheep-and-goat line is left unannotated.
